intervals.note: The founding date is not published in the sources read. January 2020 (arXiv submission of the paper that says the collaboration had been founded) is an upper bound for the start, not the founding date.
intervals.quote: have joined forces to found the Global Argon Dark Matter Collaboration (GADMC) to pursue a sequence of future experiments that will exploit this technology, starting with DarkSide-20k.

name: Global Argon Dark Matter Collaboration (GADMC)
notes: Existing record collaboration:darkside carries the aliases 'Global Argon Dark Matter Collaboration' and 'GADMC', and states that it operates 'within' GADMC; the two are kept as separate collaborations here (GADMC is the umbrella of four projects, DarkSide the DarkSide-50/DarkSide-20k team). The integrator may want to drop those two aliases from collaboration:darkside.

Membership counts are not recorded as structured data: the only figure read ('more than 400 scientists across approximately 100 institutions', arXiv:2507.11368, Sec. 5.4) is a community-report estimate, not a roster.
No official GADMC website was found.

summary.plain: An international collaboration of liquid argon dark matter projects (ArDM, DarkSide-50, DEAP-3600, MiniCLEAN) that is building DarkSide-20k in Italy and plans a 300-tonne detector, ARGO, as its final step.
summary.technical: GADMC: formed from the ArDM, DarkSide-50, DEAP-3600 and MiniCLEAN projects; a 2025 SNOLAB report counts more than 400 scientists in about 100 institutions. Programme: DarkSide-20k (50 t dual-phase TPC at LNGS, the first new experiment), the proposed DarkSide-LowMass (1.5 t, low-mass dark matter) and ARGO (400 t, 300 t fiducial; its final milestone), with underground argon from the Urania plant (Colorado) purified at Aria (Sardinia) and assayed by DArT.
